facts.business: Kenvi Jewels Limited operates as a retail-focused enterprise engaged in the sale of gold, silver, diamond and studded jewellery through its showroom in Ahmedabad, including exchange/buyback of old jewellery.
facts.related_party_note: Transactions with Suvarnakrupa Jewels Private Limited (Purchase and Sale of goods/services, Rs 1650.92 crore) and Rency Jewels Private Limited (Sale of Goods/Services, Rs 2326.27 crore) during FY 2025-26, both enterprises over which KMP exercise significant influence, approved by Board on 28-05-2025.
